verdict.rationale: Audit trails and completion certificates are a fair axis for an eSignature product, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions an audit trail, a certificate of completion, or tamper-evident sealing of signed documents. Adjacent items, such as secure agreement storage, identity verification and pre-send verification, address different capabilities and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can rely on a tamper-evident audit trail and completion certificate for every signed document
